title: Skyblock Overhaul (SBO)
description: [SBO] SkyblockOverhaul is a Mod for the Mythological Ritual event in hypixel skyblock and custom partyfinder
body:
## What it does

[SBO] SkyblockOverhaul is a feature-rich Hypixel SkyBlock mod for Minecraft Fabric supporting all current Hypixel SkyBlock versions, designed primarily for the Diana event.

---

## Installation

**Requirements:**
- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- Mod Menu (optional, for settings GUI)

Download the JAR for your Minecraft version and place in your `mods` folder.

---

## Features

### Diana Burrows
- **Spade Guess** — Guess burrow location when using spade (requires Dripping Lava Particles + Extreme particle quality)
- **Arrow Guess** — Guess from arrow direction after digging (replaces old Multi-guess)
- **Close Burrow Detection** — Auto-detect/update burrow types when near particles
- **Beacon Beam** — Visual beams for waypoints

### Diana Warp
- **Warp Locations** — Wizard, DA, Castle, Stonks
- **Don't Warp Close** — Prevents warping within 60 blocks of a burrow
- **Configurable Distance** — Adjust warp block difference and Y-level handling
- **Bad Warp Distance** — Prefer accessible warps over close but inconvenient ones

### Diana Trackers
- **Mob Tracker** — Track Diana mob kills (`/sboguis` to move)
- **Loot Tracker** — Track loot drops (`/sboguis` to move)
- **Stats Tracker** — Mobs since Inq, Inqs since Chim, etc.
- **Magic Find Tracker** — Highest MF for sticks/chimeras
- **Past Events** — View saved trackers from previous events
- **AFK Timeout** — Auto-pause after inactivity (15-900s)

### Loot Announcers
- **Chat** — Announce relics, shelmet, plushie in chat
- **Screen** — Large on-screen message for Chimera, Stick, Relic
- **Party** — Share rare drops in party chat
- **Custom Messages** — Customize with `{mf}`, `{amount}`, `{percentage}` placeholders

### Rare Mobs
- **Share/Receive** — Send and receive coordinates for King, Manti, Sphinx, Inq
- **Highlight** — Glowing effect on rare mobs
- **No Shuriken Overlay** — Shows when mob has no shuriken
- **HP Alert** — Title alert when rare mob HP drops below threshold
- **Sphinx Solver** — Auto-solve Sphinx riddles

### Customization
- **Waypoint Colors** — Custom colors for Guess, Mob, Treasure, Start, Rare Mob
- **Text Options** — Scale, shadow, opacity, distance cutoff
- **Custom Sounds** — Add `.ogg` files to `config/sbo/sounds/` for:
  - Rare spawns, burrow found, drops (Chimera, Stick, Relic, Core, Stinger, Wool, Food)

### General QOL
- **Bobber Overlay** — Track nearby bobbers
- **Legion Overlay** — Track players for Legion buff
- **Pickup Log** — Log of picked up items
- **Waypoints From Chat** — Auto-create from coordinates
- **Hide Own Waypoints** — Filter your own waypoints
- **Phoenix Announcer** — Alert when dropping Phoenix pet
- **Message Hiders** — Hide Diana, AutoPet, Implosion, Sack messages

### Party Commands
- `!w` / `!warp` — Warp party
- `!allinvite` — Invite all
- `!transfer` — Transfer party
- `!promote` / `!demote` — Manage members
- `!chim` / `!inq` / `!relic` / `!stick` — Share stats

### Party Finder
- **Auto Invite** — Auto-invite players meeting requirements
- **Auto Requeue** — Requeue after member leaves

---

## Commands

| Command | Aliases | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `/sboguis` | `/sbomove` | Move overlay GUIs |
| `/sbopf` | — | Open Party Finder |
| `/sboachievements` | — | View achievements |
| `/sbopastevents` | `/sbopde` | View past Diana events |
| `/sboclearburrows` | `/sbocb` | Clear saved burrows |
| `/sboresetsession` | — | Reset session |
| `/sbo` | — | Open SBO menu |
| `/sbohelp` | — | Show help |

---

## Keybinds

Configure in Minecraft **Options → Controls → Key Binds → SBO**:
- **Guess Warp** — Warp to current guess
- **Inquisitor Warp** — Warp to nearest inq
- **General Warp** — Warp to closest
- **Send Coords** — Send coordinates to chat

---

## Configuration

- **Config:** `config/sbo/`
- **Sounds:** `config/sbo/sounds/` (add `.ogg` files, restart required)
- **Settings:** `/sbo` or Mod Menu → SBO → Configure

---
